$description: Nightwire design tokens. The only hand-edited token source: `npm run build:tokens` generates the stylesheet token block, tailwind.preset.js and the DESIGN.md token regions.

color.$description: Layer 1 palette. Raw colours; components use Layer 2 roles.

void.$description: Surfaces — elevation through tonal progression, never shadows

blue.$description: Primary — blue for all UI chrome, headers, labels, focus

green.$description: Success / Data — green for all data values and positive states

cyan.$description: Info — cyan for metadata, secondary info, wireframes

red.$description: Danger — pink-red for errors, destructive actions, offline

yellow.$description: Warning — amber for caution, pending, degraded

purple.$description: Accent — purple for AI elements, highlights

tracking.$description: Letter spacing. Raw: DTCG dimensions allow only px and rem.

semantic.$description: Layer 2: roles that reference Layer 1, so a Layer 1 override reaches v2 consumers.

dev.cativo.nightwire.cssComment:
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Nightwire v2 — Layer 2 Semantic Tokens (additive aliases)
   v1 tokens above remain untouched. Layer 2 references Layer 1
   so any v1 override propagates to v2 consumers.
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* Text tiers (split the old --nw-text-dim into 3 contrast levels) */

knob.$description: Intensity knobs. Overridden per level by $extensions.intensity at the root.

led-glow.$description: Glow of LEDs and state indicators. Combat raises it to twice --nw-glow.

control-glow.$description: Glow of controls (switch, check, segmented, buttons). Follows --nw-glow.

progress-glow.$description: Glow of progress and step indicators. Follows --nw-glow.

loop-state.$description: Play state of the continuous loops (spinner, shimmer). Reduced motion pauses it.

rule.$description: Weight of marks drawn inside controls (check strokes, spinner ring).

accent-width.$description: Weight of accent bars (tabs, sidebar, diff, toast).

motion.$description: Bare name = enter, -out = exit. Scaled by --nw-motion-scale; loop cycles scale inversely.

uplink.$description: exit: shorter, accelerating (proposed final, pending approval)

dev.cativo.nightwire.cssComment: /* Stagger, and loop cycles (scale inversely: archive slower, combat faster) */

duration.$description: Exit duration, shorter than enter (proposed on the v3 direction board, pending approval)

easing.$description: Exit curve, accelerating (proposed on the v3 direction board, pending approval)

shadow.$description: Glow shadows (preset-only, no CSS custom property) and the overlay elevation (CSS-only).

doc.$description: DESIGN.md-only views. Leaves alias the tokens above, or hold doc-only values (K2).

sys.$description: System / Data — all body text, data readouts, code

title.$description: Display / Title — cinematic headings only, compressed with scaleX(0.82)

stamp.$description: Stamp — labels, badges, tags, button text
